items.alt: Prompt Autopsy No. 2: 6 words, 5 holes. Before: Fix this code. It doesn't work. Five holes: the error, expected vs actual, the environment, what you tried, the guardrail. After: a structured debugging prompt that asks for the cause first, then the smallest fix as a diff.

Creator Spotlight: what Fireship teaches brands about sponsor reads. Quote from Jeff Delaney, January 2026: We'll keep ads at the end of videos, not in the first 60 seconds like most youtubers. Three lessons: sponsor a format instead of a one-off, let the creator pick the ad slot, expect a no if you don't fit.
